official_identity: The current Indian Health Service Crownpoint page identifies Crownpoint Health Care Facility at Hwy Junction 57, Route 9, Crownpoint, New Mexico 87313 and describes its 20-bed hospital services.
regulatory_observation: 45 CFR 180.30 deems federally owned or operated hospitals, including hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program, in compliance with Part 180.
interpretation: CMS ownership and city/state/ZIP agreement with the current IHS hospital page support the federal scope disposition. The pages use different highway naming detail for the same Crownpoint site; this is retained as an address variant, not treated as a mismatch. This is not a claim about MRF availability or file quality.
next_action: Retain the federal scope exclusion unless CMS ownership or regulatory scope changes.
